subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 1: Language booster – Hobbies and making suggestions
outcomes: Say hobby phrases like bake a cake and build a robot.
Make suggestions with How about …?, Shall we …? and Let's …
Respond to suggestions and agree on an activity.

tf.s: After "How about" we use a verb with -ing.
"Let's going to the kiosk." is correct.
tf.why: After Let's we use the base verb: Let's go to the kiosk.

tf.s: "Shall we visit my granny?" is correct.
"What about building a robot?" is a suggestion.
"What shall we do today?" is correct word order.
"Yes, that's a great idea!" is a way to say no.
tf.why: It is a way to agree.
We bake a cake and build a robot.

tf.s: "No, I don't like fish." is a good reply to "What about visiting a fishmonger's?"
tf.why: It says no and gives a reason.

tf.s: "How about visit the kiosk?" is correct.
tf.why: We say: How about visiting the kiosk?

tf.s: "Do an experiment" is a hobby phrase in this lesson.
tf.why: do an experiment is one of the phrases.

boxes.q: Choose: How about (play / playing) board games?
Choose: Let's (go / going) to the kiosk.
Choose: Shall we (visit / visiting) my granny?
How about baking a cake? Choose a reply.
boxes.why: This reply agrees and gives a reason.

mcq.q: Which group has only hobby phrases from the lesson?
o: make a pizza, bake a cake, build a robot

mcq.q: What comes after "How about" and "What about"?
mcq.why: How about doing …? What about building …?

mcq.q: Which sentence agrees with a suggestion?
Respond to "What about building a robot?" if you like robots.
o: Yes, that's a great idea. I love robots.

mcq.q: Order the words: shall / What / do / we?
Your friend loves Science. Which suggestion is best?
mcq.why: An experiment is a good choice for someone who loves Science.
After How about we need -ing: How about baking a cake?

mcq.q: "What about visiting a fishmonger's?" "No, I don't like fish." Why does the boy say no?
mcq.why: His reason is in his reply.

mcq.q: Which two sentences mean almost the same?
o: How about making a pizza? / Let's make a pizza.
Let's make a pizza. / I made a pizza.
Shall we make a pizza? / I don't like pizza.
What about a pizza? / Pizza is a planet.
mcq.why: Both are suggestions to make a pizza.
